context: Wrote the v3 foundation ADR (docs/adr/2026-09-foundation-contracts.md, PROPOSED) and executable contracts in src/contracts (event envelope, canonical digest, ids, evidence classes, scope algebra, lifecycle payloads, delivery states, Ed25519 signing, ingress validation); 21 contract tests green, tsc clean.
rationale: R19/C21: old clients must not corrupt unknown semantics and new semantics must not be silently flattened; a strict envelope makes a newer producer's event a visible quarantine on an older consumer, while passthrough bodies let record fields evolve without an envelope bump.
summary: Envelope and lifecycle payloads are STRICT (unknown keys rejected) while created-record bodies pass unknown fields through; unknown kinds and newer envelope versions are distinct rejection codes so ingest can quarantine rather than half-apply
